const toolId = "synthetic.recovery.write";
function fixture(mode) {
	const journal = new __vite_ssr_import_2__.InMemoryEffectJournal();
	const initialStore = new __vite_ssr_import_2__.InMemoryExecutionStepStore();
	const base = (0,__vite_ssr_import_3__.phase3RuntimeInput)();
	const input = {
		...base,
		agent: (0,__vite_ssr_import_3__.phase3AgentProfile)({ tools: [toolId] }),
		userMessage: "Perform one synthetic in-memory operation.",
		budget: {
			...base.budget,
			maxDurationMs: 5e3
		}
	};
	const operationKeys = [];
	let bodies = 0;
	let captured;
	let capturedSteps;
	let entered;
	const bodyEntered = new Promise((resolve) => {
		entered = resolve;
	});
	const factory = (store, suspend, recovery) => {
		const selectedMode = recovery?.mode ?? mode;
		const authority = recovery?.journal ?? journal;
		const tool = {
			id: toolId,
			version: "1",
			description: "Synthetic in-memory counter only",
			inputSchema: { type: "object" },
			outputSchema: { type: "string" },
			risk: "LOW",
			sideEffect: "WRITE",
			idempotent: false,
			requiresApproval: false,
			execute: async (_input, context) => {
				bodies++;
				operationKeys.push(context.operationKey);
				if (suspend) {
					captured = await initialStore.loadCheckpoint(input.tenantId, input.executionId);
					capturedSteps = await initialStore.listSteps(input.tenantId, input.executionId);
					entered();
					await new Promise(() => {});
				};
				return {
					status: "SUCCEEDED",
					output: "synthetic operation done"
				};
			}
		};
		const raw = {
			list: () => [tool],
			resolve: (id) => id === toolId ? tool : undefined
		};
		return (0,__vite_ssr_import_2__.createOperationalHarness)({
			toolResultContext: { version: 1 },
			...selectedMode === "factory" ? { effectJournal: authority } : {},
			tools: selectedMode === "prewrapped" ? (0,__vite_ssr_import_2__.createJournaledToolRegistry)(raw, authority) : raw,
			stepStore: store,
			iterativeOrchestrator: new __vite_ssr_import_1__.HybridOrchestrator({ rules: [(context) => context.stepNumber === 1 ? {
				decisionType: "CALL_TOOL",
				reasonCode: "TOOL_REQUIRED",
				toolId,
				toolVersion: "1",
				toolInput: {}
			} : {
				decisionType: "RESPOND",
				reasonCode: "GOAL_SATISFIED",
				responseText: "Synthetic operation done."
			}] }),
			modelGateway: { complete: async () => {
				throw new Error("Must never call a model");
			} },
			policy: new __vite_ssr_import_3__.ScriptedPolicyEngine(),
			approvals: new __vite_ssr_import_3__.InMemoryApprovalEngine(),
			audit: new __vite_ssr_import_3__.RecordingAuditSink(),
			telemetry: new __vite_ssr_import_3__.RecordingTelemetrySink()
		});
	};
	const interrupt = async (failed = false) => {
		const controller = new AbortController();
		const running = factory(initialStore, true).run({
			...input,
			signal: controller.signal
		});
		await bodyEntered;
		controller.abort();
		await running;
		// Recreate only state durable before the body completed. This is a memory
		// crash reconstruction; the interrupted process's later writes are absent.
		const restored = new __vite_ssr_import_2__.InMemoryExecutionStepStore();
		await restored.compareAndSwapCheckpoint({
			tenantId: input.tenantId,
			executionId: input.executionId,
			expected: null,
			next: captured
		});
		for (const step of capturedSteps) await restored.recordStep(failed && step.stepType === "TOOL" ? {
			...step,
			status: "FAILED",
			errorCode: "unknown_effect"
		} : step);
		return restored;
	};
	return {
		input,
		factory,
		initialStore,
		interrupt,
		journal,
		operationKeys,
		bodyCount: () => bodies,
		checkpoint: () => captured
	};
}
